lines: One hundred and six Hegemony soldiers fell. One hundred and twenty-two from Concord.
Three hundred and thirty-six lie wounded. A thirty-bed field hospital opens tomorrow.
But one man has been here since the first morning.
Cyril Doc Zaboravljeni signed up on Day one. Nobody else from that morning is still standing.
He keeps a lucky button in his pocket. He draws his friends in the margins of his letters.
At the brickworks he shouted across the wire. An enemy answered, pretending to be an officer.
Two wounds. Four medals. Last night he won a bet at R F twelve, and two enemy soldiers went down.
Forty-six new soldiers came up the line. Two thousand three hundred and thirty-eight hold it now.
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war.
